title: カワカミプリンセス登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My days of training with Kawakami Princess are finally about to begin! Today, we'll start with…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoooa?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Magical Princess is already available for rental?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Of course, my all-time fav will always be the original series! Especially episode eight, with that one-on-one battle for the ages! Fists flying everywhere!
choice_data_list: Umm, where have you brought me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A video rental shop, of course! They have the complete box set of Princess Fighter here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I mean, you said you wanted me to tell you more about myself, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think back to the events leading up to this moment. It all started earlier today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I called Kawakami Princess to my office first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My goal was to learn more about her, particularly what her preferred running style and track type were—information vital to our upcoming training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm here. So what is it?
choice_data_list: I'd like you to tell me more about yourself.
I'd like you to tell me more about yourself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my! I see, I see… I hear you loooud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Then what are we waiting for? Come on! Let's get to it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If you want to know more about me, you have to start with the first gen! Spitfire Cutie☆Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: When I was little, I would wake up early every Sunday, rubbing my sleepy eyes as I studied how to be a princess by watching the heroic Princess Fighter.
choice_data_list: Hold on… I need a moment to process this…
Hold on… I need a moment to process this…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sure, I'll wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This "Princess Fighter" Kawakami Princess is talking about is a cartoon that airs on Sunday mornings. The heroine serves as the model princess that Kawakami aspires to become.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what I want to know about her has nothing to do with Princess Fighter…
choice_data_list: What I meant was, I'd like to know more about your running…
What I meant was, I'd like to know more about your running…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Running? My running?
choice_data_list: Yeah. We need to think about your debut race.
Yeah. We need to think about your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My debut race? Oh, I see. Then…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngyaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm so stupid! I completely misunderstood you, didn't I?! Ohhhh, I always jump the gun!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's get back to your office right away! I'll tell you everything you want to know. I'll even give demonstrations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As soon as she's done talking, Kawakami Princess bolts out of the shop, leaving me behind once again.

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: "A princess is always beautiful, graceful, and courageous! Spitfire Cutie☆Princess Fighter! A dreamer's journey never ends!"
choice_data_list: So this is the Princess Fighter she adores so much…
So this is the Princess Fighter she adores so much…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little later that afternoon, we start our training session. I set things up based on the information she gave me about her running.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Raaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… How was… that… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I compare what I just saw of her running with the information she gave me beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than short or long-distance tracks, she seems suited to mile or medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But above all, she possesses the spirit to face challenges head-on. When it comes time for a race against real opponents, I'm sure she'll burn with fiery passion.
choice_data_list: "You can become stronger than a raging tempest."
"You can become stronger than a raging tempest."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Uwah?! Th-that was…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That was the line Legendary Trainer says in episode sixteen! When Princess Fighter is locked in battle with an enemy Stopra and needs words of… encouragement…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait! How come you know that line, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: I thought I'd study up on the series a bit.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I wanted to understand the ideal you aspire to.
I wanted to understand the ideal you aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh my!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eheh… eheheh. ♪ Your efforts are very much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm… I'm going to run another lap! Watch me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Rrryaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess lets out a fierce roar as she continues to run with a smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch her charge furiously ahead, she seems to shine brilliantly with the determination to become her ideal princess.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Her candor is no doubt her greatest asset.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Yes, it is I! The first-rate Umamusume, King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The self-proclaimed first-rate Umamusume, King Halo is a racer currently in her senior year. Kawakami Princess views her as an idol.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And you would be…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I expect you to heed my words even more closely.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Candor like hers can be a source of powerful strength, but also a great vulnerability.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Make sure to train her with care and attention. You'd be surprised how important that can be to an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's no fair, Trainer! NO FAIR! How could you start talking with King and leave me out?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let me join in, too! If you don't, I won't talk to you anymore!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It seems that candor of hers is already starting to backfire…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I begin my journey to take on the Twinkle Series with the spunky Kawakami Princess.
